findings.description: The semi-truck parked outside the diner changes from a white aerodynamic cab at 00:00 to a dark green conventional truck with chrome exhaust stacks.

As the waitress gets up from the counter stool and moves to the right, an identical second waitress is seen standing at the kitchen pass-through counter in the background, resulting in two waitresses simultaneously in the frame.
